excerpt: CEBAF reached design energy in 1995. The cryomodules were evenly divided among two linacs. The energy reach of 6 GeV of CEBAF was establish in 2000; CEBAF operated at energies up to 6 GeV until 2012.
publisher: A. Freyberger for the CEBAF Commissioning Team (JLab) / JACoW
title: Commissioning and Operation of 12GeV CEBAF (IPAC2015, MOXGB2)
